items.html:
Reproduced without Safari: at390×844, resonance buttons end at858.98px while .lab clips at844px. Controls extend24px beyond the viewport; their scroll range is only4px, so scrolling cannot recover them.

Cause: fixed viewport height plus overflow:hidden, hardcoded stage-height reservation, and controls’156px minimum. Safe-area padding is also absent from active mobile content. Fix CSS sizing/scroll containment first; there is no evidence that visualViewport JavaScript is needed.

Tests miss this because they check sliders and document overflow, omitting action buttons. Add a bounds/clipping check for the bottom action row after fonts load, including reduced viewport heights. No files changed.
